business_problem: A vision for a unified go-to-market strategy Everforth is constantly seeking new ways to improve operational excellence and scale their commercial capabilities. Recently, the company made the strategic decision to consolidate their global technology and digital engineering platform, evolving to provide fully consultative solutions to clients.
solution_summary: Everforth used Sales Cloud and Data 360 to unify, deliver data and real-time insights to the sales organization, and automate manual recruiting workflows to scale capacity. Building an agentic enterprise as Client Zero To solve these operational challenges, Everforth made a major strategic bet to consolidate their operations with Salesforce, deploying Sales Cloud A1E , Professional Services, and Data 360 . Mission critical was gaining immediate efficiency through intelligent automation. Beyond their own imperative, Everforth also wanted to bring their Client Zero experience to customers. By proving out an integrative architecture internally, establishing a single data layer changed what was possible. For the first time, Everforth is harnessing AI to test and refine solutions in the real world, de-risking innovation and accelerating the path to market.

solution_components.name: Sales Cloud
solution_components.role: Stores account, opportunity, and workflow data teams use to build account snapshots and tactical recommendations for sellers.

solution_components.name: Agentforce
solution_components.role: Runs the AI agent workflows that build account snapshots and tactical recommendations for sellers.

solution_components.name: Data 360
solution_components.role: Unifies enterprise and behavioral data so teams can build account snapshots and tactical recommendations for sellers with current context.
